newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to review zero molasses import duties Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: EU to review zero molasses import duties Wednesday.

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee will review molasses import duties on Wednesday, a member state official said on Monday.
Both cane and beet duties continued suspended at zero at last week's meeting. The cif reference prices were set at 8.39 ecus per 100 kg and 12.24 ecus per 100 kg respectively.
"The import duties will be looked at on Wednesday," the official said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
